properties.title: Hizballah and the Iran Crisis
properties.description: Hizballah's role in the Iran crisis is uncertain, and its future is threatened by the ongoing US and Israeli attack on Iran.

properties.title: US Army Attack Helicopters in the Pacific
properties.description: US Army Apache attack helicopters rehearsed maritime missions in preparation for regional deployments to upcoming exercises across the first island chain.

properties.title: Swedish Forces Jam Suspected Russian Drone
properties.description: Swedish forces intercepted and jammed a suspected Russian drone near the French aircraft carrier Charles De Gaulle.

properties.title: NASA Overhauls Artemis Moon Program
properties.description: NASA announced a major overhaul of the Artemis moon program, acknowledging that the agency's plan to land astronauts on the moon in 2028 was not realistic without another preparatory mission first to lay the groundwork.

properties.title: Inside North America's First Fully Integrated Rare Earth Facility
properties.description: The Saskatchewan Research Council (SRC) in Canada is building the world's first fully integrated rare earth facility, which could reduce the West's dependence on China for rare earth elements.

properties.title: Can Rental Batteries Close the Global Electricity Gap?
properties.description: Some countries are exploring the use of rental batteries to provide electricity to areas where funding for transmission infrastructure is lacking.
